reference: Visible-Light-Promoted C–S Cross-Coupling Reaction for Synthesis of Aromatic Thioethers. Organic Syntheses, Vol. 100, pp. 234-247 (2023). DOI: 10.15227/orgsyn.100.0234. URL: https://www.orgsyn.org/demo.aspx?prep=v100p0234
experimental_procedure: In a 100 mL glass reaction tube, add 4'-bromoacetophenone, cesium carbonate, and 2-chlorobenzenethiol. Evacuate and backfill with nitrogen three times. Add dry DMSO (50 mL) to give a yellow suspension. Seal and irradiate at 456 nm with a Kessil PR160 lamp (5 cm, fan-cooled) at 23 °C with stirring (800 rpm) for 5 h. Proceed to aqueous workup and silica gel chromatography as described on the source page. [Paraphrased summary of Step A; see source URL for full text.]
notes: Step A only: coupling of 4'-bromoacetophenone with 2-chlorobenzenethiol under blue light (456 nm) in DMSO with Cs2CO3 base; N2 atmosphere; 23 °C; 5 h.
